review_basis: current e-Gov Act/Order facility and inspection provisions bound by candidate source locators
all 64 Wave 1 candidates for same-wave semantic collision and educational-value review

decisions.rationale: Installation permission is a core facility-law proposition absent from the canonical baseline.
Change permission tests a distinct pre-change legal duty from initial installation permission.
Permission decision standards test the authority's substantive compliance/public-safety gate rather than application procedure.
Completion-inspection-before-use is a high-value operational boundary with no canonical collision.
Provisional use is a concrete exception to C004 and requires a distinct condition: authority approval for unaffected portions.
Transfer notification covers ownership transition and is distinct from existing supervisor-selection notifications.
Ten-day advance notice for name/quantity/multiple changes is a precise statutory timing boundary.
Continuous maintenance of technical standards is distinct from initial permission and completion inspection.
Repair/change/relocation orders test enforcement consequences of standards noncompliance.
Completion-inspection application procedure is separate from the substantive pre-use prohibition in C004.
Authority duty to inspect without delay is a separate statutory process step and not a wording variant of C010.
Completion certificate issuance is the distinct outcome of a successful inspection.
Certificate reissue after loss/destruction is a source-explicit administrative boundary with no collision.
Ten-day return of a later-found old certificate tests a distinct post-reissue duty.
Required class/name/maximum-quantity application fields are distinct from numerical specified-quantity calculations.
Specified-quantity multiple as an application field tests administrative use of the metric, not the arithmetic proposition already covered canonically.
Change-content-and-reason disclosure is a distinct application-evidence requirement from the duty to obtain change permission.
Pre-completion inspection for applicable liquid-hazard tank work is a distinct inspection category from general completion inspection.
The 10,000 kL outdoor-tank safety-inspection threshold is a high-value quantitative facility boundary.
Periodic inspection plus record creation/retention is a distinct continuing compliance duty from safety inspection.

collision_review.note: All 20 B6 candidates test distinct facility/inspection permissions, procedures, enforcement or maintenance propositions. No material collision with the 51 canonical questions or accepted B4/B5 candidates was found.
